craft_notes: Sthāyin: cakrodaya unit 46. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 8. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: In word-mantras in all as far as that word-śakti-going is able; constantly by joined so much to be recited but by sādhakas.
l4.sanskrit_cite: padamantreṣu sarveṣu yāvattatpadaśaktigam śakyate satataṃ yuktaistāvajjapyaṃ tu sādhakaiḥ
